UPDATE patient_account a INNER JOIN patient_card_info b ON a.registry_signs = b.person_id INNER JOIN patient_card_info c ON b.id_card = c.id_card AND c.patient_master_no = 1 and LENGTH(c.id_card) = 18 AND c.id_card!='000000000000000000' SET a.registry_signs = c.person_id where c.update_status=0 ;

WITH latest_updates AS ( SELECT id, id_card, patient_master_no, update_status, update_time, person_id_generate_time, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY id_card ORDER BY person_id_generate_time DESC) as rn FROM patient_card_info ) UPDATE patient_card_info SET patient_master_no = CASE WHEN id IN (SELECT id FROM latest_updates WHERE rn = 1) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END;
